# Security & Human-Control Requirements Checklist: FLUX-88 Phase 1 (MVP)

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of security and human-control requirements before Phase 1 implementation
**Created**: 2026-11-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · constitution v1.0.0

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Approval Engine & Default-Deny (Constitution I; Spec FR-030..034)

- [ ] CHK001 Is the complete list of critical-action categories enumerated and closed (no "etc.")? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "single-use where appropriate" resolved into an explicit rule for WHICH action types allow multi-use/batch grants? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK003 Are expiry durations (or their configuration bounds) specified for approval requests? [Gap, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the revalidation contract defined — what resource state is compared, and what outcome follows a mismatch? [Clarity, Spec §US2-AS4]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for approval requests whose TARGET is deleted or changed between request and decision? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the batch-approval boundary measurable — what makes a batch "explicitly defined"? [Measurability, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements consistent between "agents MAY prepare proposed actions" (FR-031) and each agent's prohibitedOps in agents.md? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the owner-identity verification requirement for dashboard approvals specified (session freshness, re-auth for high-risk)? [Gap]

## Untrusted Content & Injection Resistance (Constitution II; Spec FR-025, SC-008)

- [ ] CHK009 Is "untrusted" propagation specified end-to-end (ingress → memory → prompt assembly → outputs)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the prompt-assembly delimiter/rendering requirement for untrusted content stated as a testable rule? [Measurability, Plan §Security Boundary 5]
- [x] CHK011 Are requirements defined for untrusted content that CLAIMS to be owner authorization (scenario 8 wording)? [Coverage: `e2e/adversarial/injection.spec.ts`, Spec §US6-AS3]
- [x] CHK012 Is there a defined adversarial test corpus requirement for SC-008, including who maintains it? [Gap closed: `e2e/adversarial/README.md`, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK013 Are trust-elevation requirements specified — how proposed/untrusted memory becomes verified, and who may do it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]

## Agent Least Privilege (Constitution II; agents.md)

- [ ] CHK014 Does every one of the 18 agents have non-empty allowedTools, prohibitedOps, memory R/W, and approval triggers defined? [Completeness, agents.md]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "specialists never inherit DOC's privileges" expressed as a testable requirement (scope check uses acting agent's identity)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Are delegation-permission requirements consistent between handoffTargets in agents.md and DOC's orchestration rules? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for an agent invoking a tool OUTSIDE its allowlist (refusal + audit + escalation)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the rule "personality never affects permissions" stated where implementers will see it (registry schema), not only in docs? [Traceability, agents.md]

## Constitution Security Requirements (auth, sessions, data)

- [ ] CHK019 Are owner-auth requirements complete: Argon2id parameters or their source, lockout duration after 5 failures, unlock path? [Completeness, Constitution §Security]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the generic-auth-error requirement paired with a no-timing-leak requirement (user-existence oracle)? [Gap, Constitution §Security]
- [ ] CHK021 Are CSRF requirements specified for every state-changing route including SSE-adjacent POSTs? [Coverage, contracts/api.md]
- [ ] CHK022 Is "secret-shaped content rejected at memory write" (FR-024) defined with detectable patterns and a false-positive handling rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK023 Are log-content requirements specified (no passwords/personal data) with a definition of what counts as personal data here? [Clarity, Constitution §Security]
- [ ] CHK024 Are audit-event requirements complete for ALL mutation classes listed in FR-070, each with actor/timestamp/target? [Completeness, Spec §FR-070]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the append-only property of audit_events stated as an enforceable requirement (DB grants), not an intention? [Measurability, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the worker's inability to mint/consume grants specified as a requirement with a defined enforcement point? [Traceability, Plan §Security Boundary 3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
